description: This source file defines functions and constants related to bundling and managing plugin build entries for a build system involving OpenClaw plugins. It includes functionality for reading plugin package manifests, determining build criteria, collecting source files, and generating build artifact lists.

methods.name: readBundledPluginPackageJson
methods.description: Reads and parses a package.json file at the given path, returning the JSON object or null if not found or invalid.

methods.name: isManifestlessBundledRuntimeSupportPackage
methods.description: Determines whether a package qualifies as a manifestless bundled runtime support package based on its name and surface entries.

methods.name: collectPluginSourceEntries
methods.description: Collects plugin source entry points from the package.json's openclaw.extensions array and setupEntry, defaulting to './index.ts' if none found.

methods.name: shouldStageBundledPluginRuntimeDependencies
methods.description: Checks whether to stage runtime dependencies based on package.json's openclaw.bundle.stageRuntimeDependencies flag.

methods.name: collectTopLevelPublicSurfaceEntries
methods.description: Scans a plugin directory for publicly accessible source files with specific extensions, excluding test or type definition files.

methods.name: collectBundledPluginBuildEntries
methods.description: Main function that scans the bundled plugin directories, reads manifests and package.json, and collects entries that should be built.

methods.name: listBundledPluginBuildEntries
methods.description: Maps the collected build entries to their respective file paths in a consistent format, suitable for building or deployment.

methods.name: listBundledPluginPackArtifacts
methods.description: Returns a list of all artifact files (JSON, package, JS files) to be generated for the plugins based on build entries.

methods.name: listBundledPluginRuntimeDependencies
methods.description: Gathers and returns sorted list of runtime dependencies needed for the bundled plugins.
